newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa to bid for Venezuela's Sidor.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa to bid for Venezuela's Sidor.

text.p: Steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) has applied to the Venezuelan government to take part in the upcoming privatization of Siderurgica del Orinoco (Sidor), Ahmsa's media office said Monday.

"We have registered. The auction announcement (for registration) contained no deadline for placing bids, but we should know by early 1997 who is eligible (for tendering bids)," a spokesman from Ahmsa headquarters in the northern city of Monclova told Reuters.
Sidor has an annual installed capacity of 3.6 million tonnes of liquid steel, the spokesman added.
Sidor is to be sold off lock, stock and barrel, including the company's steel block and direct-reduction plants, flat and non-flat products complexes, rail and port facilities and workshops.
